article.headline: Germán Berterame strikes early as Inter Miami shuts out New York City
article.summary: Inter Miami secured a 2-0 victory over New York City FC on Wednesday after an opening goal from Germán Berterame.
article.body:
The breakthrough arrived in the 20th minute when a sequence of precise passes by the Herons dismantled the New York City backline. Luis Suárez swept the ball across the goal face to find Germán Berterame, who delivered a clinical tap to put the home side in front. Despite the loss, New York City FC demonstrated crisp passing and controlled possession for the opening 20 minutes, showcasing flashes of intelligent movement that stood in stark contrast to their recent run of results. 

This result highlights the persistent offensive struggles facing the Bronx side throughout the 2026 season. While New York City FC maintained structural integrity and controlled the ball for stretches, they remained unable to convert their momentum into goals against Dayne St. Clair. The match represents the final outing of a three-game road trip for the visitors, who have found points increasingly difficult to secure as the season progresses.

According to LiveScore, the visitors entered the match following a defeat to Chicago Fire FC, leaving the team appearing mentally drained. While coach Pascal Jansen opted to start Alonso Martínez for the second consecutive match, the team's inability to find the back of the net proved decisive. Even as the match progressed and Miami increased their time on the ball, the defensive resolve of the home side ensured that New York City FC finished the encounter without a goal. 

As the 2026 campaign continues, the pressure remains on the New York City attack to find the clinical finishing required to convert possession into points. The loss reinforces the current narrative for the squad, where consistent tactical efforts have repeatedly failed to yield the necessary results on the scoreboard.

article.headline: Museum drawer fossil identified as new 120 million-year-old feathered dinosaur species
article.summary: Researchers have identified Invictibellatrix amberina, a new megaraptoran species found in an Isle of Wight fossil collection after being overlooked for nearly 100 years.
article.body:
For nearly a century, a chunk of a fossilized skull sat forgotten in a Natural History Museum drawer, waiting to be recognized as one of the most significant finds in recent years. This creature, Invictibellatrix amberina, represents the first megaraptoran ever discovered in Europe, providing a missing link in the history of these agile, two-legged carnivores.

The identification of this dinosaur is a milestone for understanding the Early Cretaceous period, roughly 120 million years ago. While researchers have long known that the Isle of Wight serves as a treasure trove for paleontological remains, the fact that this specific bone remained hidden since its acquisition in 1924 highlights the untapped potential of existing museum collections. This discovery proves that the next major breakthrough in dinosaur research may already be resting in a storage facility.

Lead author Dr. Cassius Morrison of University College London and his team used CT scans to create a 3D model of the skull fragment, comparing it against various theropods like tyrannosaurs and spinosaurs. Their findings, published in the journal Royal Society Open Science, suggest that this predator was about three to four metres long and stood over a metre and a half tall. Unlike the massive Tyrannosaurus rex, which might have considered humans too small to hunt, this tiger-sized carnivore would have likely viewed a human as perfectly sized prey. The dinosaur, whose name translates to "unconquered female warrior," likely possessed feathers and utilized giant, curved claws measuring up to 20cm to hunt small dinosaurs, lizards, and mammals.

As experts continue to study the remains, the discovery confirms that megaraptorans were not limited to other continents, fundamentally shifting current knowledge of their geographical spread and evolutionary history.

He then walked over to his chair, kicking his destroyed racket, before hitting his hand through the lid of a drinks cooler. His hand then started bleeding as he informed the umpire he would need a physio and a three-minute medical time-out.

Dhanush spotted arriving at the theatre to watch Rajinikanth's Jailer 2
news.og_title: Dhanush spotted arriving at the theatre to watch Rajinikanth's Jailer 2
news.og_desc: On Thursday morning, actor Dhanush was spotted arriving at Rohini Theatre in Chennai to watch superstar Rajinikanth's film 'Jailer 2'. Media and fans were thrilled to see Dhanush as he quickly walked in, waving at the paps. Dhanush was married to Rajinikanth's daughter, filmmaker and playback singer Aishwaryaa Rajinikanth. In 2024, they parted ways. Speaking of Jailer 2, the film is produced by Sun Pictures and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. It follows the success of the first instalment, raising expectations among fans. The second part also features Vidya Balan in a prominent role. The trailer was released a few days before the film's release. It introduced Rajinikanth's Muthuvel Pandian in a seemingly quieter phase of his life, only for the calm to end soon as events connected to his past pull him back to the world of violence. Mithun Chakraborty, Jackie Shroff and Mohanlal also star in the film. The movie's music is composed by Anirudh Ravichander. Fans are celebrating the release of Jailer 2 with immense excitement, with people gathering from different countries to be part of the celebrations. A fan, Shantini, who has come from Sydney, Australia, told ANI, So many expectations. We are so happy; can't wait. Reach is amazing; we tried to do the first day first show as soon as we could. It has to be better than the first part. Fans have also travelled all the way from Malaysia to celebrate Jailer 2. They were spotted singing, dancing, and cheering for Rajinikanth together outside the theatres. (ANI)

news.title: Iraq will not become a launchpad for attacks on Saudi Arabia, vows prime minister
HRH the Crown Prince, Iraqi Prime Minister Hold Talks in Riyadh; Al-Zaidi Affirms Rejection of Attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.og_title: HRH the Crown Prince, Iraqi Prime Minister Hold Talks in Riyadh; Al-Zaidi Affirms Rejection of Attacks on Saudi Arabia
news.og_desc:
Riyadh, October 14, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, received at Al-Yamamah Palace in Riyadh on Wednesday Prime Minister of the Republic of Iraq Ali Falih Al-Zaidi, who expressed the Iraqi government's strong condemnation and denunciation of the attack targeting King Khalid International Airport and the attacks on civilian and vital facilities in the Kingdom, describing them as a threat to regional security and stability.
    Al-Zaidi affirmed his government's firm stance against allowing Iraqi territory to be used as a launchpad for any aggression or acts affecting the security of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and other countries in the region, and its commitment to the principles of good neighborliness and respect for the sovereignty of the Kingdom and brotherly nations.
    The two sides discussed regional developments and coordination of efforts to enhance the region's security and stability.
    They also reviewed Saudi-Iraqi relations, with HRH the Crown Prince emphasizing the Kingdom's keenness to strengthen cooperation between the two countries in various fields, particularly security coordination.
    -- SPA
18:05 Local Time 15:05 GMT
